profile.ja: 自身の髪の毛を操る“毛遁の術”を使う学生対魔忍。髪を自在に操るだけでなく、毛の硬さを変えたり、切断した毛を飛ばしたりといった事も可能。毛に痛覚はないが、感触などのフィードバックはある程度感じる事ができる。切断した髪も触れていれば操れるが、手放すと数分程度でただの髪の毛に戻る。一度に伸ばせる髪の量には限界があり、無限に使える訳ではないので、基本的にはハサミを武器として使い、髪の毛は必要な分を切断して使用する戦闘スタイルをとる。性格は明るく快活で、男女問わず友人が多く、学校で男女問わず得意のヘアカットを頼まれては休み時間に髪を切っている。そんな距離感の近さからか男からの告白は絶えないが、特定の異性と付き合う様子はなく、恋愛に興味がなさそうに思われているが、実は男女の事に興味津々で耳年増でもある。ただ、同じ毛遁使いの父親が全身の体毛を武器にする姿を見ているのが理由で毛深い男が苦手なようである。
profile.en: She is a student Taimanin who uses the "Moujin no Jutsu," a technique that manipulates her own hair. She can not only manipulate her hair freely, but also change its hardness, cut it, and use it as a projectile. Although her hair does not have pain receptors, it can provide some feedback in terms of touch. Cut hair can be controlled as long as she is in contact with it, but it will return to being ordinary hair after a few minutes if she lets go. Since there is a limit to the amount of hair that can be extended at one time, she basically uses scissors as a weapon and cuts her hair to use it in battle. She has a bright and cheerful personality, and has many friends, both male and female, at school. She often cuts her friends' hair during breaks, and her approachable nature has led to numerous confessions from boys, although she does not seem to be interested in romance. However, she is actually very interested in relationships between men and women, and has a lot of knowledge about such things. The reason she is not interested in boys is because her father, who also uses the Moujin no Jutsu, uses his body hair as a weapon, making her uncomfortable around hairy men.

text.ja: 私は櫛延澄香、キミの先輩になるかな？　でも隊長はキミだからね、指示はしっかりよろしく！
text.en: I'm Kushinobe Sumika, and I'll be your senior, I suppose? But since you're my Captain, I'll make sure to follow your instructions properly!

text.ja: 私の忍法はちょっと変わっててね……髪の毛を操る、毛遁の術っていうの。伸ばしたり動かしたり、硬くしたり――まぁ色々とできるよ
text.en: My ninja technique is a bit unusual... I manipulate my hair using the "Moujin no Jutsu." I can extend it, move it around, make it harder... I can do all sorts of things with it.

text.ja: わっ、ちょっと、こらっ！　痛みとかはないけど、感触は伝わるんだから……いきなり触られると、びっくりするでしょ
text.en: Hey, wait a minute! I don't feel pain or anything, but I can sense the touch... so it's a bit of a shock when you suddenly touch me like that.

text.ja: このハサミ？　これは武器でもあるし、あとは髪の毛を切るのに使うよ。切った髪を武器にしたり、飛び道具にしたりね
text.en: This scissors? It's also a weapon, and I use it to cut my hair. I can use the cut hair as a projectile or a weapon.

text.ja: 無限に武器を調達できるって思われそうだけど、一定期間で伸ばせる量は決まってるからね。ご利用は計画的に、ってとこかな？
text.en: You might think I can use my hair as a weapon indefinitely, but there's a limit to how much I can extend it at one time. So, I have to use it strategically.

text.ja: さて、それじゃあ実戦だ。あとは身をもって、私の術を理解してもらおっかな♪　ある程度、全力でいくからね？
text.en: Now, let's get to the real battle. I'll show you my technique in action, and I'll go all out, so be prepared!

text.ja: シャンプーとコンディショナー、変えてみたんだけど……どう？　え、いい匂い？　あははっ、それはよかった♪
text.en: I changed my shampoo and conditioner, and... how do you like it? You think it smells good? Ahah, I'm glad you like it!

text.ja: あ――あはは、見てたんだ。まぁたまに、告白されたりするよね……そういうの苦手で、オッケーしたことはないんだけどさ
text.en: Ah... ahah, I knew you were watching. I get confessions from guys all the time, but I've never really been interested in romance.

text.ja: に、苦手なのは恋愛だけで……エッチとかそういうのには、すっごく興味あるから……もっと、見せてほしい……キミの、チ……チン、ポ……
text.en: I'm not really interested in romance, but... I'm really interested in sex and that kind of thing. I want to see more... your thing... your penis...

text.ja: あ――うん、いいよ……私のこと見ただけで、チンポおっきくしてくれて……すごく嬉しい。それじゃ、気持ちよくしてあげる……髪の毛で、ね
text.en: Ah... yeah, it's okay. Just looking at me makes your penis hard, and that makes me really happy. So, I'll make you feel good... with my hair.
